# VaultGuard Security Skill

Use this skill for any authentication, authorization, vault, credential, export/import, secret storage, browser storage, clipboard, session, or security-review task.

## Checklist
- Identify trust boundaries and attacker capabilities.
- Trace where plaintext and ciphertext exist.
- Check server responses for unnecessary sensitive fields.
- Check browser persistence, clipboard, auto-lock, and XSS exposure.
- Check auth/session/token lifecycle and authorization ownership.
- Check logs/errors/analytics for secret leakage.
- Check import/export size, parsing, validation, and path handling.
- Require independent review for security-sensitive changes.

Do not infer security properties from comments; verify the implementation.
